articles.title_cn: 短时工作与预防性储蓄
articles.abstract_en: During the COVID-19 crisis, most OECD countries used short-time work (subsidised reductions in working hours) to preserve employment. This paper documents that short-time work affects the behaviour of firms (supply) and households (demand). First, using household survey data from Germany, we show that the consumption risk of short-time work is lower than that of unemployment. Second, we construct a New Keynesian model with heterogeneous workers and firms, incomplete asset markets and labour market frictions. Short-time work weakens workers’ precautionary savings motive and lowers labour costs. This reduces the level and volatility of both the separation and unemployment rate at the cost of tying workers to less productive firms. Quantitatively, the positive employment effects dominate the productivity losses.
articles.abstract_cn: 在COVID-19危机期间，大多数经合组织国家采用短时工作（补贴性减少工作时间）来维持就业。本文记录了短时工作影响企业（供给）和家庭（需求）的行为。首先，利用德国家庭调查数据，我们表明短时工作的消费风险低于失业。其次，我们构建了一个包含异质性工人和企业、不完整资产市场以及劳动力市场摩擦的新凯恩斯模型。短时工作削弱了工人的预防性储蓄动机并降低了劳动成本。这降低了离职率和失业率的水平及波动性，但代价是将工人束缚在生产率较低的企业中。从数量上看，积极的就业效应超过了生产率损失。

articles.title_en: The Causal Effect of Income on Market Social Responsibility
articles.title_cn: 收入对市场社会责任感的因果效应
articles.abstract_en: We investigate the relationship between consumers’ incomes and socially responsible consumption that mitigates negative externalities. We conduct laboratory and online market experiments in which firms and consumers can exchange products that differ in the degree to which they diminish negative external impacts at the expense of higher production costs. Our treatments exogenously vary consumers’ incomes. Across all three experiments, higher income causes an increase in the quantity of socially responsible products purchased and at least slightly increases the share of such products as part of total consumption. However, increases in total consumption resulting from higher income can increase negative externalities.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了消费者收入与减轻负外部性的社会责任消费之间的关系。我们进行了实验室和在线市场实验，其中企业和消费者可以交换那些在增加生产成本的同时减少负面外部影响程度不同的产品。我们的处理方式外生地变化消费者的收入。在所有三个实验中，较高的收入导致购买社会责任产品的数量增加，并且至少略微增加了这类产品在总消费中的份额。然而，由较高收入引起的总消费增加可能会增加负外部性。

articles.title_en: Bank Liquidity, Interbank-Rate Setting and Heterogeneous Lending Responses
articles.title_cn: 银行流动性、银行间利率设定与异质性贷款响应
articles.abstract_en: Central banks move the interbank borrowing rate through nominal operations that alter the private sector’s portfolio of fiat money and government bonds. This paper elucidates a mechanism by which such operations move the interbank rate, thereby affecting bank lending and thence the wide economy. At the core is a liquidity constraint to which bank lending is subject. By affecting the maximal tightness of banks’ liquidity constraints, the aggregate portfolio of fiat money and bonds determines the interbank rate. Accordingly, an operation that alters the portfolio moves the interbank rate. The tightness of the liquidity constraint depends on a bank attribute related to money circulation and affects banks’ responses to monetary policy. When the central bank (say) decreases the interbank rate, liquidity-unconstrained banks decrease their lending rates, but contrary to received wisdom, maximally constrained banks increase theirs.
articles.abstract_cn: 中央银行通过改变私人部门持有的法定货币和政府债券组合的名义操作来调整银行间拆借利率。本文阐明了一种机制，通过该机制，此类操作影响银行间利率，进而影响银行贷款乃至整个经济。核心在于银行贷款面临的流动性约束。通过影响银行流动性约束的最大紧度，法定货币与债券的总组合决定了银行间利率。因此，改变组合的操作会移动银行间利率。流动性约束的紧度取决于与货币流通相关的银行属性，并影响银行对货币政策的响应。当中央银行（例如）降低银行间利率时，流动性不受约束的银行会降低其贷款利率，但与普遍认知相反，受最大约束的银行则会提高贷款利率。

articles.abstract_en: This paper highlights the disagreement channel of corporate foreign currency borrowing. In our model, if domestic agents have better information than foreign lenders on the state of the economy, foreign currency borrowing might arise if the fundamentals are strong relative to what public signals suggest to foreigners. In these situations, international markets overestimate future currency depreciation, which increases the cost of borrowing in domestic currency. Domestic agents then borrow more in foreign currency because they disagree with international lenders’ pessimistic assessment. This mechanism is consistent with the data: empirically, we show that, controlling for fundamentals, negative public signals are associated with positive domestic currency excess returns and with more foreign currency borrowing.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文强调了企业外币借款中的意见分歧渠道。在我们的模型中，如果国内代理人对经济状况的信息优于外国贷款人，那么当基本面相对于公共信号向外国人暗示的情况更为强劲时，外币借款可能会出现。在这些情况下，国际市场高估了未来货币贬值，这增加了以本币借款的成本。国内代理人因此更多地借入外币，因为他们不同意国际贷款人的悲观评估。这一机制与数据一致：实证上，我们表明，在控制基本面因素后，负面的公共信号与正的本币超额回报以及更多的外币借款相关联。

articles.title_en: Parental Leave Benefits and Gender Inequality: Evidence from a Benefits Cap for High-Earning Mothers
articles.title_cn: 育儿假福利与性别不平等：基于高收入母亲福利上限的证据
articles.abstract_en: I use the universe of tax returns in Germany and a regression kink design to estimate the impacts of mothers’ parental leave benefit amounts on within-couple earnings inequality. I make use of a benefits cap to estimate the causal impacts for high-earning women: a group for which earnings inequality is particularly large. A lower mother's benefit amount results in a reduced gender gap in earnings that persists beyond the benefit period for at least nine years after the birth. The longer-term impacts are driven by couples where the mother earned more than her partner pre-birth. Simulations suggest that a 10% reduction in the benefit amount could reduce long-run child penalties in sample couples from 63% to 46%.
articles.abstract_cn: 我利用德国税务申报的全样本和回归断点设计，估计了母亲育儿假福利金额对夫妻内部收入不平等的影响。我利用福利上限来估计对高收入女性的因果影响：这一群体的收入不平等尤为严重。较低的产妇福利金额导致性别收入差距缩小，且这一效应在产假结束后至少持续九年。长期影响主要由产前母亲收入高于伴侣的夫妻驱动。模拟结果表明，福利金额减少10%可将样本夫妻的长期子女惩罚从63%降至46%。

articles.title_en: Does Third-Party Policing Increase Crime? Evidence from Nuisance Ordinances
articles.title_cn: 第三方警务会增加犯罪吗？来自滋扰条例的证据
articles.abstract_en: Although the adoption of third-party policies (i.e., policies targeting non-offending parties to address misconduct by individuals within their control) is growing worldwide, its effect on crime remains unclear. Using Ohio data from 2000 to 2014, this study examines the impact of nuisance ordinances, a policy that penalises landlords for disturbances on their properties. The findings indicate an 18% increase in burglaries and a 28% rise in vehicle thefts. Indirect evidence suggests that these effects are driven by an increase in homelessness, prompting more individuals to seek shelter in buildings and vehicles. These findings highlight that third-party policing may backfire.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管第三方政策（即针对非违规方以处理其控制下个人不当行为的政策）在全球范围内的采用日益增多，但其对犯罪的影响仍不明确。利用俄亥俄州2000年至2014年的数据，本研究考察了滋扰条例的影响，该政策对房东因其房产上的干扰行为进行处罚。研究结果显示，入室盗窃增加了18%，车辆盗窃上升了28%。间接证据表明，这些效应是由无家可归现象增加所驱动的，促使更多人寻求在建筑物和车辆中避难。这些发现凸显了第三方警务可能适得其反。

articles.title_en: Discipline Reform, School Culture and Student Achievement
articles.title_cn: 纪律改革、学校文化与学业成就
articles.abstract_en: Does relaxing strict school discipline improve student achievement, or lead to classroom disorder? We study a 2012 reform in New York City public middle schools that eliminated suspensions for non-violent, disorderly behaviour. Math scores of students in more-affected schools rose by 0.05 standard deviations over three years relative to other schools. Reading scores rose by 0.03 standard deviations. Only a small portion of these aggregate benefits can be explained by the direct impact of eliminating suspensions on students who would have been suspended under the old policy. Instead, test score gains are associated with improvements in school culture, as measured by the quality of student-teacher relationships and perceptions of safety at school. We find no evidence of trade-offs between students, with students benefiting even if they were unlikely to be suspended themselves.
articles.abstract_cn: 放宽严格的学校纪律是否会提高学生的学业成就，还是会导致课堂混乱？我们研究了纽约市公立中学2012年的一项改革，该改革取消了针对非暴力、扰乱行为学生的停学处分。受影响较大的学校学生的数学成绩在三年内相对于其他学校提高了0.05个标准差。阅读成绩提高了0.03个标准差。这些总体收益中只有一小部分可以归因于取消停学对在旧政策下可能被停学的学生的直接影响。相反，考试成绩的提升与学校文化的改善有关，这通过学生与教师关系的质量以及在校安全感的感知来衡量。我们没有发现学生之间存在权衡的证据，即使学生自己不太可能被停学，他们也能从中受益。

articles.abstract_en: We investigate the impact of providing households with disaggregate consumption feedback and develop a framework to assess its welfare implications. In the context of smart metering, we find that the provision of appliance-level feedback causes an energy conservation effect of 5% relative to a group receiving standard (aggregate) feedback. Hence, a smart meter rollout will be substantially more effective if appliance-level feedback is provided. We also show that the current regulatory approach to assess consumer surplus overestimates the welfare gains from smart meter feedback.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了向家庭提供分类消费反馈的影响，并开发了一个评估其福利含义的框架。在智能计量的背景下，我们发现，与接受标准（汇总）反馈的组相比，提供电器级反馈会产生5%的节能效果。因此，如果提供电器级反馈，智能电表的推广将更加有效。我们还表明，当前评估消费者剩余的监管方法高估了智能电表反馈带来的福利收益。

articles.title_cn: 反洗钱法规的意外后果
articles.abstract_en: Tighter money-laundering regulations in offshore financial havens may inadvertently spur incentives to launder money domestically. Our study exploits regulations targeting financially based money laundering in Caribbean jurisdictions to examine their impact on the creation of front companies and other money-laundering practices in US counties. Predictions on the effects are ambiguous: stricter regulations could either increase domestic money laundering through substitution or decrease it by disrupting laundering networks. We find strong evidence of substitution. Counties with prior financial exposure to these jurisdictions experience a rise in business activities after regulatory tightening. The effect is greater in sectors at high risk of money laundering, while firms hire fewer workers and inflate revenues. Exposed counties also see higher shares of cash-based and misvalued real-estate transactions. Our work provides the first indirect evidence of real and financial unintended effects of foreign money-laundering regulations.
articles.abstract_cn: 离岸金融避税天堂更严格的洗钱法规可能无意中刺激了在国内洗钱的动机。我们的研究利用针对加勒比司法管辖区金融洗钱的法规，考察其对美国各县空壳公司设立及其他洗钱行为的影响。对影响的预测是不明确的：更严格的法规可能通过替代效应增加国内洗钱，或通过扰乱洗钱网络减少洗钱。我们发现了强有力的替代效应证据。在法规收紧后，先前对这些司法管辖区有金融敞口的县经历了商业活动的增加。这种效应在高洗钱风险行业更为显著，而企业雇佣更少的工人并虚增收入。受影响的县还看到现金交易和估值不当的房地产交易比例上升。我们的工作提供了外国洗钱法规对真实和金融领域意外影响的首次间接证据。

articles.title_cn: 打击腐败能否减少庇护主义？
articles.abstract_en: Does combating corruption reduce clientelism? To investigate this question, we focus on a policy that has been widely used across the world: anti-corruption audits. We examine the impact of Brazil’s prominent audit programme on clientelism using a novel survey of rural citizens. Randomised audits reduce politicians’ provision of campaign handouts, decrease citizens’ demands for private goods, and reduce requests fulfilled by politicians. We investigate mechanisms by which audits may reduce clientelism, and find that audits significantly reduce citizens’ willingness to supply clientelistic votes.
articles.abstract_cn: 打击腐败能否减少庇护主义？为探究此问题，我们聚焦于一项在全球广泛采用的政策：反腐败审计。我们利用一项针对农村居民的新调查，考察巴西著名的审计项目对庇护主义的影响。随机审计减少了政客提供竞选施舍，降低了公民对私人物品的需求，并减少了政客满足的请求。我们探究了审计可能减少庇护主义的机制，并发现审计显著降低了公民提供庇护性选票的意愿。

articles.title_en: Politics at the Dinner Table: Thanksgiving and Social Influences on Political Polarisation
articles.title_cn: 餐桌上的政治：感恩节与社交对政治极化的影响
articles.abstract_en: Can socialising with people who disagree with you change your opinions and reduce political polarisation? I answer this question using a shock that induces us to socialise and discuss politics with a more ideologically diverse set of people: Thanksgiving. Using a sample of American and Canadian survey respondents, I show that people converge towards their families’ viewpoints in the week after Thanksgiving, and that this significantly reduces opinion polarisation. People with very left-wing family move about 11% of a standard deviation to the left in the week of Thanksgiving, with a slightly larger response in the opposite direction for people with very right-wing family. The probability of having a centrist opinion rises by 3.9% just after Thanksgiving. There are no significant effects on affective polarisation. The effects are short-lived in this setting, but provide novel quasi-experimental evidence on how real-life interactions can alleviate ‘echo chamber effects’.
articles.abstract_cn: 与持不同意见的人进行社交是否会改变你的观点并减少政治极化？我利用一个促使我们与更多意识形态多样化的人群进行社交和讨论政治的冲击来回答这个问题：感恩节。使用美国和加拿大调查受访者的样本，我表明人们在感恩节后一周内会向家人的观点趋同，并且这显著减少了意见极化。家庭非常左翼的人在感恩节那一周向左移动约11%个标准差，而家庭非常右翼的人则向相反方向移动略大的幅度。在感恩节刚过，持有中间派观点的概率上升3.9%。对情感极化没有显著影响。在这种情境下，影响是短暂的，但提供了关于现实生活互动如何缓解‘回音室效应’的新颖准实验证据。

articles.abstract_en: In mid-2016, all journals of the American Economic Association stopped including significance stars in their regression tables. This policy aimed to reduce the emphasis on statistical significance and shift the focus to the broader economic importance of research findings. This study examines the impact of this change on p-hacking and publication bias. I employ a difference-in-difference design, as well as the battery of tests proposed by Elliott et al. (2022b). I find no statistically significant effect of this policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 在2016年中期，美国经济协会的所有期刊停止在回归表中包含显著性星号。该政策旨在减少对统计显著性的强调，并将焦点转向研究发现的更广泛经济重要性。本研究考察了这一变化对P值操纵和发表偏倚的影响。我采用了双重差分设计，以及Elliott等人（2022b）提出的系列检验。我发现该政策没有统计学上显著的影响。

articles.title_en: Civilian Evacuation During War: Evidence from Ukraine
articles.title_cn: 战争期间的平民疏散：来自乌克兰的证据
articles.abstract_en: In times of war, evacuating civilians from conflict zones is of critical importance to their survival and well-being. However, many people are hesitant to evacuate. While text-based nudges have been studied in other contexts, their effectiveness in encouraging evacuation during armed conflict remains under-explored. We conducted a controlled survey experiment in Ukraine in July 2022—during the ongoing full-scale Russian invasion—by varying the framing and informational content of automated alert messages. Our findings suggest that providing individuals with an evacuation plan in the message is crucial, while the specific framing of the message itself does not play a significant role in the perceived effectiveness of the messages.
articles.abstract_cn: 在战争时期，将平民从冲突区域疏散对其生存和福祉至关重要。然而，许多人对于疏散犹豫不决。虽然基于文本的助推在其他情境中已有研究，但其在武装冲突期间鼓励疏散的有效性仍未得到充分探索。我们在乌克兰于2022年七月进行了一项受控调查实验——正值俄罗斯全面入侵期间——通过改变自动警报信息的框架和信息内容。我们的研究结果表明，在信息中为个人提供疏散计划至关重要，而信息本身的具体框架在感知信息有效性方面并未发挥显著作用。
